title: Role Mastery: 90-Day Sprint Playbook
author: Aisha Kumar
body:
Summary
-------
This playbook defines a repeatable, measurable 90-day onboarding and early performance framework designed to accelerate new hires from orientation to independent impact at Redwood Inference. It is intended for hiring managers, people-ops partners, onboarding buddies, and engineering leads. The approach emphasizes concrete outputs, time-bound checkpoints, manager-led coaching, and integrated hiring-to-onboarding feedback loops.

Scope
-----
Applies to all full-time new hires across engineering, product, and platform teams. Individual contributors (ICs) and managers follow the same 90-day structure but with role-specific success criteria. Temporary contractors should adopt a condensed 30–60 day variant (see exceptions).

Principles and goals
--------------------
- Clear outcomes: each 30-day segment has 2–3 measurable impact milestones.
- Manager ownership: hiring manager is primary owner of the new hire's success.
- Skill-gated progress: completion of checkpoints grants role badges to signal readiness.
- Feedback loops: continuous feedback (weekly 1:1 + weekly async pulse) and formal check-ins at 30/60/90.

Definitions
-----------
- Time to First PR: days from start_date to first approved code contribution against a production or staging service. Target: <= 14 days for engineering ICs.
- Time to Production: days from start_date to first independently deployed change. Target: <= 60 days for production-facing roles.
- Role Mastery Badge: an internal tag granted when 90-day rubric passes.

Roles & Responsibilities
------------------------
- Hiring manager: owns goals, delivers weekly 1:1s, completes 30/60/90 reviews.
- Buddy: peer assigned for day-to-day questions and demo walkthroughs (first 30 days).
- People-ops onboarding partner: coordinates equipment, IT access, and initial orientation sessions.
- Mentor (optional): senior technical mentor for career coaching and escalation.

90-Day Structure (high level)
----------------------------
- Day 0 (pre-boarding): accounts, hardware, important reading list, first-day calendar.
- Day 1–30 (Foundation): orientation, knowledge transfer, first-ticket PR, team rituals.
- Day 31–60 (Execution): own a small enhancement or bugfix, contribute to a cross-team sync, begin measurable feature work.
- Day 61–90 (Independent Impact): deliver a scoped feature/experiment, run a post-deploy check, prepare knowledge-sharing session.

Concrete 30/60/90 Checkpoints and Evidence (required)
---------------------------------------------------
Note: evidence should be linked as comments in the 30/60/90 review Confluence page.

Day 0 (Pre-boarding checklist)
1. Hardware provisioned and validated (IT ticket: # hardware-{{employee_id}}).
2. Accounts: SSO, JIRA, Confluence, GitHub, CI/CD, Slack, internal dashboards.
3. Team calendar invites created for recurring rituals (standups, demo, 1:1 cadence).
4. First-week goals sent by manager (3 bullet points).

Day 1–30: Foundation (ownership: manager + buddy)
Mandatory milestones:
- Attend orientation and security briefing.
- Complete required compliance training (list below).
- Submit first PR against a non-critical repo or documentation change; link to PR.
- Run local dev environment and complete end-to-end smoke test.
Performance metrics and targets:
- Time to First PR: target <= 14 days.
- Dev environment readiness: day 3.

Day 31–60: Execution (ownership: manager + team lead)
Mandatory milestones:
- Scope and deliver a small, production-adjacent task (e.g., feature flag rollout, pipeline fix).
- Lead a short design/tech demo in the team.
- Complete initial evaluation rubric (self + manager).
Targets:
- Time to Production (first change): target <= 60 days.
- Peer reviews: at least 4 substantive code reviews.

Day 61–90: Independent Impact (ownership: manager + mentor)
Mandatory milestones:
- Deliver a scoped feature or measurable experiment; produce a short post-deploy summary (metrics, rollout notes, rollback plan).
- Host a knowledge-sharing session (30m).
- Manager completes final 90-day evaluation.
Outcomes for Role Mastery Badge:
- All mandatory milestones completed with evidence links.
- Manager and peer rubric scores average >= 3.5/5 on core skills.

Onboarding Compliance Training (required during first 30 days)
- Security & Data Handling (online module) — target completion: Day 7.
- Privacy and Customer Data policy — Day 14.
- Code of Conduct & Reporting — Day 7.
- Role-specific mandatory trainings (e.g., SOC2 basics for infra-facing roles) — Day 30.

Sample 30/60/90 Evaluation Rubric (table described in text)
Columns: competency, rating-1, rating-3, rating-5, evidence-required.
- Competency: Technical delivery — 1: cannot complete basic tasks; 3: completes mid-level tasks with coaching; 5: independently delivers production-scope work. Evidence: PRs, deploy notes.
- Competency: Communication — 1: limited updates; 3: clear async updates and meeting participation; 5: leads cross-team syncs. Evidence: meeting notes, Slack threads.
- Competency: Ownership & Reliability — 1: misses deadlines; 3: reliable on small scopes; 5: proactively prevents incidents. Evidence: incident blameless postmortem, task completion trend.

Manager checklist for 1:1s and feedback cadence
- Weekly 1:1: agenda should include blockers, learning plan, 30-day micro goals (10–15 mins check), and career aspiration touchpoint (10–15 mins).
- Weekly async pulse: manager sends a 3-question pulse in Slack (progress, blocker, request).
- 30/60/90 review meeting templates: 45 minutes each, with pre-read of evidence links and a shared doc for scoring.

Hiring → Onboarding Feedback Loop
--------------------------------
1. At offer acceptance, hiring manager completes a ‘handoff note’ summarizing chosen ramp tasks and initial mentor pairing.
2. After 30 days, hiring manager and people-ops complete a hiring calibration form indicating whether interview signals matched early performance.
3. If mismatch identified, people-ops will run a hiring calibration review to update interview rubric for that role.

Badge System and Role Gates
--------------------------
- Badges: Foundation (30d), Execution (60d), Role Mastery (90d). Badges are represented as Confluence labels and internal profile flags.
- Gate policy: if a new hire fails to meet a required gate, manager must provide a remediation plan with milestones and specific coaching assignments within 7 calendar days. Remediation length: 30–60 days.

Escalation and Performance Concerns
-----------------------------------
- Low urgency: manager documents concerns in a private coaching plan and increases 1:1 frequency. People-ops notified.
- Medium urgency: after 30 days of missed milestones, create a performance improvement plan (PIP-lite) with people-ops support.
- High urgency: if critical security/compliance or severe behavioral issues are found, people-ops and legal are engaged immediately and an investigation is launched.

Templates & Snippets
--------------------
1) First-week goals (manager email template)
Subject: Welcome to Redwood — Your first-week goals
Body:
- Day 1–3: get dev env running and read the team runbook.
- Day 4–7: submit first doc PR and attend three team rituals.
- Day 8–14: pick first ticket with mentor and scope the work.

2) 30-day review form (manager + self) — (fields described)
- Summary of accomplishments (text)
- Blockers and plan (text)
- Rating per competency (1–5)
- Evidence links (PRs, docs, dashboards)

3) Dev environment checklist (CLI snippet)
- git clone git@github.com:redwood-inference/team-repo.git
- ./scripts/bootstrap.sh --env=staging
- ./scripts/run-smoke-test.sh

Alignment with performance cycles and calibration
------------------------------------------------
- 90-day reviews feed into quarterly calibration for individual contributors. Managers should flag promotion-ready hires in the Q2/Q3 calibration window if Role Mastery badge is achieved and promotion signals are present.
- Use the attached rubric and evidence to seed the calibration packet.

Metrics & success indicators for the onboarding program
-----------------------------------------------------
- Median Time to First PR (engineering): <= 12 days.
- % of hires with Role Mastery at 90 days: target 75% across engineering.
- 30/60/90 review completion rate: 100% (people-ops tracks).
- Hiring-to-Onboarding calibration adjustments implemented within 30 days after identification: target 90%.

Appendices
---------
A. Example 90-day review flow (numbered steps):
1. New hire uploads evidence doc 48 hours before the 90-day meeting.
2. Manager pre-reads and adds comments.
3. 45-minute meeting: 10m check-in, 20m review of evidence & scoring, 15m career and next steps.
4. Manager publishes outcome (Pass / Remediation / Escalate) to people-ops.

B. Recommended reading for new hires (links described)
- Team README and architecture overview — required.
- Production runbooks — recommended for infra-facing roles.
- Product FAQs and roadmap excerpts — optional but encouraged.

C. Exceptions and special cases
- International hires in locations with restricted tooling: people-ops will coordinate alternative secure access flows; timelines may be adjusted.
- Senior lateral hires: managers may shorten the 90-day gate if prior evidence and references are strong, but must document rationale in the hiring handoff note.

Related pages and references
---------------------------
- Onboarding orientation schedule (team-specific) — see team calendar templates.
- Hiring intake and skill gating protocol — see related page in people-ops.

Document maintenance
--------------------
- Owner: people-ops (Aisha Kumar). Review cadence: annual or after any major hiring process change.
- Change log: 2028-06-01 created; 2029-01-12 updated to add badge gating policy and escalation tiers.
